description:
Calculate the 95% Confidence Intervals for the mean 'Mischief' score for both the 'Cloak' and 'No Cloak' groups using the Invisibility Cloak dataset. 

1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/InvisibilityCloak.csv' in Jamovi.
2. Ensure 'Cloak' is set as a Nominal or Ordinal variable (it may import as Continuous).
3. Use the 'Exploration' > 'Descriptives' analysis.
4. Split 'Mischief' by 'Cloak'.
5. Enable 'Confidence Interval for Mean' (95%) in the Statistics options.
6. Save the Jamovi project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/Mischief_Estimation.omv'.
7. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ci_report.txt' reporting the Lower and Upper bounds for both groups using exactly this format:

No Cloak (0) Lower: [value]
No Cloak (0) Upper: [value]
Cloak (1) Lower: [value]
Cloak (1) Upper: [value]
